AI-Powered Content Calendar Planner v1.0.0

- Launches an AI-driven tool for generating 30/60/90-day content calendars using brand voice, analytics, and trend data.
- Integrates with Google Analytics and major platforms (WordPress, HubSpot, Google Calendar, Slack, Airtable).
- Supports content strategists, agencies, and solopreneurs with multi-channel, data-driven campaign scheduling.
- Offers brand voice analysis, industry trend alignment, and platform-specific content recommendations.
- Includes content repurposing, engagement optimization, and gap identification features.
- Provides setup instructions, sample prompts, and example output for easy onboarding.
